digest.component_or_area: LLM gate usage recording and analysis
propositions: LLM gate runs compute but discard loop-vs-breadth signal (tool_calls, tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, request_limit, tool_calls_limit, finish_reason) at the write boundary in record(), losing the data needed to tune gates or distinguish loops from breadth
Gate runs with no REBAR_USAGE_LOG env var set record nothing to disk, forcing operators to re-run instrumented gates to answer tuning questions that should be answerable by query
The success path never computes tool-call shape metrics or wall-clock duration, leaving success runs non-comparable to failure runs on the same gate
Tuning advice in docs/llm-framework.md (identify and fix loops by monitoring recursion) is unactionable because the system records no spend data distinguishing loops from breadth
Existing failure_usage() reducer already computes the complete loop-vs-breadth signal; the defect is that record() filters it out via _FIELDS allowlist, a wiring job not new accounting
Gate runs default to recording usage to .rebar/usage.jsonl in the checkout repo root when in a gate session and no env var is set, enabling operators to query spend without instrumentation
